expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked login'; } return 'no login button'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText.toLowerCase(); const cards = (t.match(/daily github pr triage|weekly dependency audit|ssl certificate expiry monitor|nightly platform health check/g) || []).length; const active = t.includes('active'); const paused = t.includes('paused'); return 'cards=' + cards + ';active=' + active + ';paused=' + paused + ';installBtns=' + document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label*=install i]').length; })()
